text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired for `eu-west-az2` - high 5xx rate on inference endpoints (routed traffic). auto-detected spike at 17:12 UTC.
pagerduty: Incident P12345 created and routed to on-call.
sre_jamie: acked. I'm taking primary. checking metrics + logs now.
eng_raj: seeing CPU on the shard hosts jump and NIC errors in the fabric logs. Early signs of packet drops.
prod_ops_leah: how widespread? any customer-impact numbers?
sre_jamie: initial telemetry: 12 customers with request failures, error rate ~38% for the last 3m on az2. Latency also up for surviving requests.
oncall-tilly: adding runbook: `az-network-flap` -> consider divert, scale, or failover.
eng_raj: can we divert traffic off az2 to eu-west-az1/az3? routing supports divert to capacity pool.
sre_jamie: starting routed-divert now (policy=prefer-latency, fallback=az1). Command: `redwoodctl route divert --from az2 --to az1,az3 --weight 0.0`
prod_ops_leah: divert in progress, sending small batches first. watching heatmap.
eng_raj: logs show `eth0: tx timeout` repeatedly on 10.2.4.* nodes. NVMe stats fine. suspect NIC driver/firmware flapping.
incident-bot: autoscale triggered: +8 workers in az1, +6 workers in az3 (to absorb diverted traffic).
sre_jamie: divert ramped to 60% after warmup, error rate on overall region dropped to 9%. Good signal.
customer-success-maya: alerted top affected customers and opened tickets with temporary mitigation notes. keeping them updated.
oncall-tilly: PD escalation window in 12m if not stable. Any mitigation to patch az2 rather than divert?
eng_raj: we can try restart of network agent on the impacted instances, but that risks short bursts of fail/reconnect. prefer rolling restarts with delays.
prod_ops_leah: initiating rolling-agent-restart: `for node in $(list-az2-nodes); do ssh $node sudo systemctl restart net-agent && sleep 25; done`
sre_jamie: restarting 1/12 done. so far no regressions. Monitoring for reconnect storms.
incident-bot: alert: PD escalation tier-1 -> tier-2 (no ack from secondary)
oncall-tilly: handoff note: if we need sustained capacity, we'll activate regional failover (fail traffic permanently to az1/az3) and run a deeper root-cause investigation.
eng_raj: one restarted node recovered NIC, tx errors ceased. two others still show errors. I’m pushing firmware re-provision job to the remaining hosts.
prod_ops_leah: divert now steady at 85% off az2. Customer-visible errors down to ~2-3%.
sre_jamie: updating internal status: `incident: investigating - partial divert in place - recovery in progress`.
status-bot: status page updated: `Partial outage in eu-west-az2, traffic diverted to neighboring AZs. Customers may see elevated errors; working on remediation.`
customer-success-maya: sending update to affected customers: short note + ETA 1h while we stabilize.
oncall-tilly: 20m until my shift ends; will hand off to @sre_jamie for active mitigation and to @eng_raj for firmware actions. please keep PD updated.
sre_jamie: acking handoff. I'll keep the thread and escalate if we need failover activation.
eng_raj: firmware job kicked. also placing a short-term BPF packet-drop filter on the worst node to avoid noisy retransmits: `tc qdisc add dev eth0 ingress filter ...` (will monitor for side-effects).
incident-bot: note: PD P12345 still open - last activity 8m ago.
prod_ops_leah: monitoring shows node-level error counts dropping slowly. plan: if nodes recover to healthy in 30m, we start gradual route back (30% steps).
customer-success-maya: customers responded: most okay with divert, one requests detailed RCA when resolved. Logging the request.
oncall-tilly: leaving now - handoff complete. next on-call: @oncall-tilly -> @sre_jamie (primary) and @eng_raj (secondary infra).
sre_jamie: noted. continuing to watch; will re-evaluate revert timeline in 25m.
status-bot: scheduled status update pushed in 15m.
eng_raj: firmware fixes applied to 8/12 nodes; three fully recovered; two still flapping. one node we're isolating from routing to avoid noisy neighbor impact.
prod_ops_leah: isolation command: `redwoodctl node isolate --node node-az2-07 --reason \"nic-flap\"` executed. rerouting completed.
sre_jamie: overall region error rate now 1.4%, az2 errors at 6% on remaining nodes. Looks contained.
incident-bot: PD P12345 marked `under control` by on-call. awaiting final confirmation before close.
customer-success-maya: prepping customer RCA bundle (timeline, mitigation, next steps).
sre_jamie: plan: keep divert active until all az2 nodes show <0.5% 5xx for 10m and firmware propagation completes. then gradual revert 10% steps with close monitoring.
eng_raj: agree. I'll stay on-call for the revert window.
prod_ops_leah: tagging this thread with `incident:az2-network` and archiving logs.
status-bot: final note queued: next update will be \"mitigation complete\" or further action.
incident-bot: closing note: handing off to postmortem if we close without remaining flaps.

(End of thread)
